notes.title: #2 Develop Update
notes.content:
Hi aspiring greedy capitalists,

as promised, here is a deepening of the dynamics of Hedge Fund Tycoon.
In this new simulator, players will have the opportunity to trade a wide range of financial products, including:

1. Stock shares: You will be able to invest in shares in listed companies. If applicable, the shares are entitled to a quarterly dividend; the share paid to the shareholders is decided by the CEO or the control fund. Holding at least 20% of the share capital and if the fund turns out to be the majority shareholder you will have the opportunity to manage and control the company.

2. Corporate bonds: Bonds are a safer alternative to shares. Bonds are debt securities at the maturity of which the nominal value invested and the regular interest will be obtained throughout the holding period. The coupon is quarterly.

3. Government bonds: You can invest in government bonds, giving you a safe choice for managing your portfolio. The coupon is variable and depends on the rating, the duration can be 10 or 20 years.

4. Commodities: You will have the opportunity to trade commodities such as oil, gold and other physical goods, as a result of price fluctuations on the commodity market. No periodic returns accumulate.

5. Options: You can experiment with advanced trading strategies using options, both for hedging and for speculation. Options are financial derivatives that give the holder the right, but not the obligation, to buy or sell a particular share at a predetermined price within a specified maturity date. It is possible to hold a maximum of 10% of the share capital.

6. Short selling: is a trading strategy in which an investor sells a security that he does not actually own at the time of sale. The objective is to profit from the previewed decrease of the price of the stock in the time. You can short out 20% of a company’s share capital.

Get ready for a realistic and engaging experience in the world of finance and trading. Stay tuned for more details on the game launch!
